intro: Tracks of hooves stretch off from the Shady Rest Inn, whose bare frame still smokes. A few can be seen clearly, while more rows are nearly lost in the marsh's soft ground. Krog at Brackenwall Village is the one to report them to.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hoofprints... It could have been the quilboar, I suppose. Or maybe even the centaur. Their presence in the Barrens is not insignificant, and I would not think it a stretch to commit such an act.
Did I tell you? It wasn't just that the inn was burned down... The owner's woman and pup were killed. Bad business, that.
Nonetheless, I will send Kagoro to find where the tracks lead.
